notes.title: Hotfix 1
notes.notes: Fixed problem with people's campaign not working in Russian version.

notes.title: Russian localization and font tuning
notes.notes: We've added a Russian translation and fixed a few problems with the translations. There may still be some problems, but we'll try to catch and fix them. Cheers and have a nice day.

notes.title: Polish language and a little quality of live
notes.notes: Hello everyone I hope you have a good day today we come the first minor update. We added Polish language and adjusted the whole system for easy adding of translations. Also, we added the ability to drag units in the interface. We also fixed a few minor bugs. Have a nice day.
